answerTimeUp: ⏱ Answer time is up: no more help this turn. Pick your number!
backupCopied: Code copied! Paste it into a message or a note.
backupErr_damaged: Incomplete or damaged code: copy it again in full.
backupErr_format: This is not a backup code from the game.
backupExportText: Copy this code and keep it safe. It does not include the game in progress.
backupHint: Save or restore rank, XP and records.
backupImportText: Paste your backup code here (it starts with NEF1-).
backupIntro: Keep a backup code (in a message or your notes): it brings back your rank, XP and records on a new phone or after reinstalling.
backupReplaces: It will replace your current progress:
badgeHow_brain: Get 3 sums right in one case
badgeHow_hound: Win at Genius level without throwing the net
badgeHow_lynx: Win with no mistake, with an exact catch
badgeHow_net: Catch the number with the net
captPick: Tap a number (1 to {max}), then choose your capture.
chDesc: Numbers 1 to 100. The number jumps: ±7, mirror, ×2… sometimes without saying which way! Reason, use your notebook, and catch it in as few turns as possible. Net: 3 numbers, 3 times.
chFormulaEndless: Score: 1000 − 45 per extra turn, −5 per question, ±10 per sum (right / wrong), −20 per missed capture (−40 with the net, −50 if you win with the net). No time bonus.
chFormulaTimed: Score: 1000 − 45 per extra turn, −5 per question, ±10 per sum (right / wrong), −20 per missed capture (−40 with the net, −50 if you win with the net), +2 per second left. Missing on purpose never pays.
chMathGood: {equation} = {result}. The number is frozen and you get a hint!
chMathGoodMoved: {equation} = {result}. You get a clue, but no freeze left: the number moved.
chMathGoodPick: {equation} = {result}. Choose the question that helps you most!
chRulesPass: Not sure? “Let it go”: no catch this turn (no penalty), but the number moves.
chRules_easy: Jumps of 3, 5 or 7, always announced. Each correct sum freezes the number and gives the best clue.
chRules_hard: Like Medium, plus ×3 and sometimes two jumps in a row. 3 jumps in 10 hide their direction. A correct sum lets you CHOOSE your question among 3. Only 1 freeze per game.
chRules_medium: Jumps of 7 to 13, mirror and ×2 (above 100, take away 101). 1 jump in 5 hides its direction: the number may be on either side! 3 freezes per game; after that a correct sum gives the clue but the number moves.
footerGame: One hint max, then you must guess a number.
foundDesc: You picked {n} — that’s right! +10 points for {player}.
guessDesc: Tap a number to try your luck. Correct: +3 · Wrong: −1.
handoffText: Pass the phone. Other players, no peeking! 😉
helpHint: Shows the numbers still possible. Off by default: the detective has to work it out!
helpPlayerHint: 💡 Help = possible numbers shown in green (off by default).
heroText: A hidden number keeps escaping. Think carefully… then take a guess!
keypadHint: Type a number from 1 to {max}, then choose your capture.
languageHint: Language changes instantly, even during a game.
levels: Choose a level, at any age
levelsFree: Levels have nothing to do with age: choose by mood and experience. Anyone can start with the easiest one.
m1ch: Right: a clue (and the number is frozen 🧊 if you have a freeze left).
m2: Each ⭐ = +1 point at the end of the game.
m2ch: +10 points. Right answers in a row make a combo 🔥.
m2chT: +10 points and +8 s on the clock.
m3: Time limit, and the number moves.
m3ch: Wrong: −10 points and it makes a crazy jump.
mathBad: {equation} = {result}. No hint, but you keep your turn.
mathGood: {equation} = {result}. You earn a star and a hint!

mathTimeout: Time’s up! {equation} = {result}. No hint, but you keep your turn.
mathTimerHint: ⏱ The timer starts when you open the challenge.
miniTip: 💡 Tip: one question crosses out several numbers at once. Then the number moves: shift what you know!
missDesc: You picked {n}, but it wasn’t right. −1 point.

mission_precise: Catch the number with an exact catch
mission_shift: Use “Shift my marks” in your notebook
missionsIntro: No timer: take your time. Each mission gives +{xp} XP and a new one arrives.
modeRaceSub: First to catch it wins, the others play for the podium. Nobody? Points decide.
modeScoreSub: {n} turns. Catch +10, net +4 (3 nets each). Best score wins.
motionHint: If motion bothers you or the phone is slow.
mvHidden: Jump of {k}, direction unknown: it may be on either side!
nbMoves: The notebook follows every move of the number.
nbOff: Help is off: work it out yourself!
nbShiftHint: The number moved! Cross out by the clue first, then shift.
nbTapHint: Tap a number to cross it out (or bring it back).
nbZoomHint: Tap a range to cross out its numbers.

notebookIntro: Past questions, maths, moves and guesses.
officeNote: One record per level. Every level is open at any age.
oldClue: The clue describes its position before moving.
oneCandidate: Only one number left! Give it a try.
passDesc: No catch this turn. The number takes the chance to move…
passHint: No catch this turn: no penalty, but the number moves.
pauseText: The timer is stopped. Resume whenever you’re ready!
possibleDesc: Green numbers still match all the clues.
proGuess: ⚡ No help: it won’t move first, but you have no clue.
proQuestion: Sure answer · 🧠 +1 if you catch it
q3ch: −5 points, then a crazy jump (+7, ×2, mirror 1 ↔ 100…).

qDouble: Is twice the number greater than {k}?

q_turn: Where is that little number hiding?|Eyes open, detective!|A new case begins!
questionsChange: New questions every turn. One hint per turn.
quit: Leave this game and return home?
raceNewNumber: A new number hides: the others finish the round and keep hunting.
raceNewsNext: A new number is hiding. Find it to take place {n}!
resultSub: Read the result and watch the number move.
rpAskText: See its whole route from the start: every clue, every jump, until the capture.
rpEscaped: Nobody caught it: it was on {n}.
rpSettingHint: Replay the number’s path after a capture.
rpStart: At the start, the number was hiding on {n}.
rule1: Ask a question (catch the number right after: +1 bonus), solve a maths challenge (⭐ = +1 point at the end), or try your luck straight away.
rule2: After the hint, the number moves a few places, but you keep your turn.
rule3: To end your turn, pick a capture: 🎯 precise (+10 / −1) or 🕸️ magic net on 2 or 3 neighbouring numbers (+4, or −1 per number if the net is empty), 3 times per game.
ruleCard1: Ask a question or solve a sum: the detective helps you narrow it down.
ruleCard2: After every clue the number moves! Remember to shift what you know.
ruleCard3: Guess the exact number, or throw your net over a few neighbours.
ruleExample: The number always moves: 1 step on Little, 1 or 2 steps on Medium and Big, left or right. After the maximum, it wraps to 1. Genius level: it jumps ±3 or ±5, doubles (×2) or goes through the mirror (1 ↔ 50, 2 ↔ 49…).
rulePoints: Race: the first to catch the number wins; points only break ties. Points: exact catch +10, net +4, −1 per missed number, and each ⭐ (correct sum) is worth +1.
secondaryInstruction: You can get one hint or solve a maths challenge before guessing.
settingsTip: Switch languages without restarting your game.
soloBest: Your best at this level: {n} turns
soloLoseDesc: The number was hiding on {n}. Try again!
soloLoseEncourage: You found new clues. Try again whenever you like!
soloWinDesc: You caught the number in {turns} turn(s)!
timerHint: Global turn timer: Little 75 s, Medium 70 s, Big 90 s, Genius 100 s. Answer timer: question 25 / 20 / 20 / 20 s, maths 30 / 30 / 45 / 45 s. The ⏸ button pauses everything.
tipLoss: watch how the number moves and try again!
tipMisses: this time, use one more clue before aiming.
tipNextLevel: perfect case! Fancy trying the {level} level?
tipNoMiss: great! Now try a case without a single miss.
tipPerfect: perfect case on the hardest level: hats off, detective!
tipPrecise: try a precise capture to earn the precision bonus!
tipThreeStars: {n} turn(s) fewer to get three stars!
tipTwoStars: try to finish in 6 turns or fewer for two stars!
tip_chFreeze: Well done! A correct sum freezes the number: it did not move this turn. (Medium: 3 freezes per game, Hard: 1.)
tip_double: It jumped with ×2 or ÷2! Remember to multiply or divide what you know.
tip_hidden: I didn’t see which way it jumped! The number may be left or right: keep both possibilities in your notebook (“Shift my marks” does it for you).
tip_mirror: The mirror! The number jumps to the other side: 1 becomes {max}, 2 becomes {max}−1…
tip_mod101: ×2 (or ×3) in Challenge: multiply, and if you go over 100 take away 101. Example: 60 × 2 = 120, 120 − 101 = 19.
tip_moved: The number just moved! What you knew slid with it: shift your ideas before guessing.
tip_net: Not sure? The net catches several neighbouring numbers at once, but scores fewer points.
title: The Number Hunt
turnTimeoutDesc: Time’s up: this turn is lost (0 points). The number uses it to run away!
tut0: Practice: this time you can see the hidden number. It is on {n}, somewhere between 1 and {max}. In a real game, it is invisible!
tut1: Ask a question to close in on it: the answer is always yes or no.
tut2: It is not greater than {k}: every number above is crossed out in your notebook.
tut3: After every clue, the number runs away: here +1, it goes from {from} to {to}. Your whole notebook shifts with it, by one step!
tut4: Your turn! Tap a number, then 🎯 precise capture (1 number, +10) or 🕸️ net (2 neighbours on Little, +4).
tut5: In a real game the number is invisible: use questions, maths (⭐ + a clue) and your notebook 📓, and remember to shift everything when it runs away. Race: first to catch it wins. Points: best score after several turns.
tutInviteText: The tutorial shows in one minute how to ask a question, follow the number as it runs away and catch it. You can also start it later from the home screen.
tutLoop: And at the end of the grid? A number on 8 does +1: it lands on 9. If it does +1 again, it does not fall off: after 9 comes 1. The path loops around, and so does your notebook!
tutLoopAsk: 👉 Tap the square where it lands after 9 + 1.
tutLoopNo: Not quite: after 9, you start again at the beginning of the grid. Try again!
tutLoopOk: ✅ Yes! 9 + 1 → 1. Now it is your turn to catch it.
tutMiss: Missed: the number is on {n}. In a real game, it would have run away again! Try again.
tutMissNet: Empty net ({nums}): the number is on {n}. Try again!
